changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: The Optomed entry matches the device name its uploads carry.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality im SET device = 'optomed', auto_match_ae_title = COALESCE(NULLIF(im.auto_match_ae_title, ''), im.device) FROM study s WHERE s.study_id = im.study_id AND s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE' AND im.code = 'FUNDUS_OPTOMED' AND lower(COALESCE(im.device, '')) = 'optomedlumo';

rollback.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality im SET device = 'OPTOMEDLUMO' FROM study s WHERE s.study_id = im.study_id AND s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE' AND im.code = 'FUNDUS_OPTOMED' AND im.device = 'optomed';

changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Performed boxes the 2026-11-02 seed skipped, where the item exists now.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO imaging_modality_item_binding (imaging_modality_id, role, laterality, item_oid, performed_value, created_by_user_id) SELECT im.imaging_modality_id, 'performed', 'OU', v.item_oid, '1', 1 FROM imaging_modality im JOIN study s ON s.study_id = im.study_id JOIN (VALUES ('BCVA', 'I_HEALT_BCVA_PERFORMED'), ('OCT_SPECTRALIS', 'I_HEALT_OCT_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'I_HEALT_CLARUS_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_REMIDIO', 'I_HEALT_REMIDIO_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_OPTOMED', 'I_HEALT_OPTOMED_PERFORMED') ) AS v(code, item_oid) ON v.code = im.code WHERE s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.oc_oid = v.item_oid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality_item_binding b WHERE b.imaging_modality_id = im.imaging_modality_id AND b.role = 'performed' AND b.laterality = 'OU');

changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: Reason boxes the 2026-11-02 seed skipped, where the item exists now; never auto-written.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO imaging_modality_item_binding (imaging_modality_id, role, laterality, item_oid, performed_value, created_by_user_id) SELECT im.imaging_modality_id, 'not_performed_reason', 'OU', v.item_oid, '1', 1 FROM imaging_modality im JOIN study s ON s.study_id = im.study_id JOIN (VALUES ('BCVA', 'I_HEALT_BCVA_NOT_PERFORMED_REASON'), ('OCT_SPECTRALIS', 'I_HEALT_OCT_NOT_PERFORMED_REASON'), ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'I_HEALT_CLARUS_NOT_PERFORMED_REASON'), ('FUNDUS_REMIDIO', 'I_HEALT_REMIDIO_NOT_PERFORMED_REASO'), ('FUNDUS_OPTOMED', 'I_HEALT_OPTOMED_NOT_PERFORMED_REASO') ) AS v(code, item_oid) ON v.code = im.code WHERE s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.oc_oid = v.item_oid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality_item_binding b WHERE b.imaging_modality_id = im.imaging_modality_id AND b.role = 'not_performed_reason' AND b.laterality = 'OU');
